anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: The Angel Posting House & Livery: Guildford's Historic Hub for Live Entertainment & Gastronomy
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Step into The Angel Posting House & Livery, a historic gem on Guildford's vibrant High Street, where centuries of charm meet modern revelry. Experience our acclaimed Cabaret Bar with live music and karaoke, savor traditional favorites in our inviting restaurant, and unwind in elegantly appointed rooms. Perfectly positioned to explore Guildford Guildhall and Castle Grounds, we offer a unique blend of heritage, lively entertainment, and warm hospitality, making every stay a memorable journey into local culture.
